name: MCAGCC Twentynine Palms
tagline: The Marine Corps' largest live-fire combat training base, in California's Mojave high desert.
_note: Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center (MAGTFTC), Mojave high desert (San Bernardino County, CA). BAH MHA CA032 (Twentynine Palms MCB). Housing: Liberty Military Housing (formerly Lincoln), 2,210 homes and apartments, waits of 30 days to 12 months. Schools: Morongo Unified, Condor Elementary on base, no DoDEA. Medical: Naval Hospital Twentynine Palms (Robert E. Bush), 24/7 ER, inpatient care, labor and delivery. Corrected 2026-11-13 from Military OneSource, DHA, CDE DataQuest, CDTFA, California DMV, BOE, DeCA and MCCS (page-builder research/palms-facts.md). California is TRICARE West. Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx; may sit on the base rather than the town), off-base ZIP 92277 is the town (base addresses use 92278).

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: The Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center at Twentynine Palms is the Corps' largest base and its premier live-fire, combined-arms training ground. Marine units from across the force rotate through its vast desert ranges to prepare for combat.
Set in California's Mojave high desert, it is remote and self-contained: Palm Springs Airport is about 60 miles away, and Highway 62 is the main road to the rest of Southern California.

source.label: Military OneSource, MCAGCC Twentynine Palms overview

data.subtitle: Morongo Unified runs the basin's public schools and BAH is the same wherever you live, so the choice is how far west along Highway 62 you go. Each step west adds drive time, and rents and prices run higher than in the town of Twentynine Palms.
intro: Base housing is the shortest commute, but waits run from 30 days to 12 months by rank and bedrooms (Military OneSource). Off base, the town of Twentynine Palms is about 11 minutes from the Main Gate (estimate, no traffic), with a typical rent of $1,494 and home value of $245,396 (Zillow, September 2026), below Joshua Tree's and Yucca Valley's.

Joshua Tree (about 32 minutes) and Yucca Valley (about 40) cost more: typical rent $2,005 and $1,827. The Coachella Valley is 73 minutes or more. Water and sewer differ too: Twentynine Palms relies on septic systems, and the regional water board has banned new and failing septic systems in Yucca Valley, which is building sewers in phases.

recommendations.advice: Liberty Military Housing runs 2,210 homes and apartments on base and in town. Waits run from 30 days to 12 months by rank and bedrooms; call the Military Housing Office at 760-830-6611 as soon as you have orders.

The town of Twentynine Palms is about 11 minutes from the Main Gate, with the lowest typical rent of the main towns ($1,494, Zillow, September 2026). Sales tax is 7.75% as of October 1, 2026; voters decided a 1% increase (Measure G) on November 3, 2026, so confirm the current rate.

July averages a high of 104 degrees (NOAA normals). The National Park Service says flash floods nearby are most common in late summer and early fall, and a July 2024 storm closed part of Adobe Road for most of a week.

recommendations.who: West on 62: Joshua Tree and Yucca Valley
recommendations.advice: Joshua Tree and Yucca Valley are about 32 and 40 minutes from the Main Gate. Joshua Tree's typical rent rose 13.6% in a year, and San Bernardino County's Consolidated Plan says short-term rental housing may be negatively impacting the Joshua Tree area. In Yucca Valley, check the sewer status of any address.

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: The Main Gate is on Adobe Road north of the town of Twentynine Palms. A March 2018 news report said it was open 24 hours and the Condor and Ocotillo commuter gates only at set weekday hours; confirm current hours with the base. Anyone driving on base needs a current REAL ID driver's license.
The Visitor Center is Building 901 at the Main Gate, 760-830-6794. Military OneSource lists weekday hours of 5 a.m. to 9 p.m.; other sources list shorter hours, so call first.

source.label: Military OneSource, Twentynine Palms motor vehicles

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: Liberty Military Housing (formerly Lincoln Military Housing) runs housing: 2,210 homes and apartments for married and bachelor personnel, in 10 family housing areas on base and in the town of Twentynine Palms, by Military OneSource's count (Liberty lists 15 communities). Neighborhoods include Ocotillo Heights on base and Vista Del Sol in town, and there are 83 RV spaces on base.

Waits run from 30 days to 12 months depending on rank and bedrooms, and summer is usually very busy. Military OneSource lists the Military Housing Office in Building 1525 on Fifth Street, 760-830-6611, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.; the base asks you to call it before you sign any private lease.

source.label: DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA CA032 (Twentynine Palms MCB)

sections.title: Schools
data: Military OneSource says Morongo Unified School District is responsible for all public K-12 schools in the Morongo Basin, including Condor Elementary on base and the schools in Twentynine Palms, Joshua Tree and Yucca Valley, and lists no DoD schools. The district's 2024-25 four-year graduation rate was 84.3%, against 87.5% statewide (California Department of Education).

Coachella Valley addresses such as Desert Hot Springs and Palm Springs are not in Morongo Unified, so confirm the district for any address. The School Liaison is in Building 1417 on Fourth Street, 760-830-1574.

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves. Around Twentynine Palms it also depends on how far west you live, and on the water, sewer and flood risk for the address.
rent: Your tour is short or your orders feel uncertain.
You prefer on-base housing for the short commute and community.
You're waiting for base housing, which can take up to 12 months for some ranks.
Typical rent in the town of Twentynine Palms ($1,494, Zillow, September 2026) is below E-5 BAH; Joshua Tree's ($2,005) is above E-5 BAH with dependents ($1,980).
buy: You expect to be here three or more years and want to settle in town.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity.
You've checked the septic or sewer status and the flood risk for the address.
You've found a home you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. In the year to September 2026, Zillow's typical home value fell 1.1% in Twentynine Palms and 0.4% in Yucca Valley, and rose 2.4% in Joshua Tree. California's general property tax rate is 1% of assessed value, which starts at your purchase price, plus voter-approved bonds, and the $7,000 homeowners' exemption is for an owner-occupied principal residence on January 1. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics, and at a remote desert base, planning ahead matters even more.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book lodging before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your command and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Call the Military Housing Office (760-830-6611) as soon as you have orders: waits run from 30 days to 12 months by rank and bedrooms. The base asks you to call before signing any private lease.

steps.title: Sort base access and your vehicle
steps.text: If California isn't your legal residence, you can keep your car's home-state registration if it's in your or your spouse's name and insured. A car registered only in a dependent's name must be registered in California within 20 days. Active-duty members are exempt from needing a California driver license. Anyone driving on base needs a current REAL ID driver's license.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Contact Morongo Unified early (Condor Elementary is on base) and bring records and immunizations. The School Liaison is at 760-830-1574.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at Robert E. Bush Naval Hospital.

data.a: It's the Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center, the Corps' largest base and its premier live-fire, combined-arms training ground, set in the Mojave high desert.

data.q: Do families live on or off base?
data.a: Both. Liberty Military Housing runs 2,210 homes and apartments on base and in town, with waits of 30 days to 12 months by rank. Off base, families live in Twentynine Palms or farther west along Highway 62 in Joshua Tree and Yucca Valley.

The town of Twentynine Palms is just south of the base; Joshua Tree and Yucca Valley are farther west along Highway 62. Joshua Tree National Park is next door, and Palm Springs Airport is about 60 miles away.

data.q: Does California tax my military pay?
data.a: Per California Franchise Tax Board guidance, a member stationed in California is taxed on military pay only if California is their legal residence. Ask the base legal assistance office to confirm. For 2025 through 2029, California lets retirees exclude up to $20,000 a year of military retirement pay if federal adjusted gross income is no more than $125,000 (single) or $250,000 (joint).
Twentynine Palms is MHA CA032. Use the calculator above for your grade.
